deployment_target: Raspberry Pi via systemd (parent monolith). No new deployment artefacts — this feature is a server-side refactor of the alert-notification rendering layer that ships as additional Go source files inside the existing single static binary already running as `ultron-ap.service`. No Dockerfile, no docker-compose.yml, no SQLite migration, no new HTTP endpoint, no background daemon. One optional env var (ULTRON_PUBLIC_URL) added to .env.example. Project Phase-5 rejection history (2026-03-18) and the help-page / insights-engine / lan-devices / settings-revamp feature precedents establish this deployment posture deliberately.

TestTC_TMU_016f_MissingThresholdRendersNA asserts the body contains '(threshold n/a)' when Rule is nil. Renderer path: render.buildMetricLine in internal/notify/render/render.go.

requirement_compliance.title: Human-readable subject line with host + friendly metric label

Friendly label table aligns with the existing engine convention (cpu, ram, disk, temp) AND the spec aliases (cpu_usage, mem_usage, disk_usage, cpu_temp).

requirement_compliance.title: Elapsed-since-breach or absolute timestamp
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_TMU_019h_ElapsedSinceBreach: FirstFiredAt=now-80s renders 'for 1m 20s' and absent ISO timestamp. requirement_compliance.evidence: Renderer support: TestTC_TMU_020h_SystemdSurfaceBlock (full block: unit + state + active since + 3 journal lines), TestTC_TMU_020e_JournalTruncationTo600 (≤600 chars + '… (truncated)' suffix on 1500-char input), TestTC_TMU_020z_EmptyJournal (empty distinguished from error path with 'no recent journal entries'). Production messages today render rule-context blocks (subject + threshold + footer) for systemd fires without the surface-specific journal block.

requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_TMU_023h_FooterPublicURL: ULTRON_PUBLIC_URL=https://ultron.example.com → footer is the last non-empty line and equals '[Open dashboard](https://ultron.example.com/alerts)'. requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_TMU_025h_ServiceNameUnderscoreAndDotEscaped, TestTC_TMU_025e_AsterisksInJournalLineEscaped, TestTC_TMU_025f_AllSpecialCharsEscapedExactlyOnce (covers full MarkdownV2 special set), TestTC_TMU_025_DotInHostnameEscaped, TestTC_TMU_025_EmptyAndPlainPassthrough, TestTC_TMU_025_UTF8RoundTrip, TestTC_TMU_025z_AsciiPrintableTable, plus FuzzEscapeV2 (round-trip property). requirement_compliance.title: Probable-cause / situation line in plain language
requirement_compliance.evidence: Cause derivation: TestTC_TMU_029h_CPUTopProcess ('top: ffmpeg (78%)'), TestTC_TMU_029m_RAMTopProcess ('top: chromium (1200 MB)'), TestTC_TMU_029d_DiskFreeSpace ('/ at 95% — 1.2 GB free'), TestTC_TMU_029t_TemperatureClimbing, TestTC_TMU_029_TempStableAndCooling, TestTC_TMU_029s_SystemdLastErrorLine, TestTC_TMU_029x_DockerExitCode137, TestTC_TMU_029_DockerLogsFallback, TestTC_TMU_029f_TimeoutOmitsLine (200ms budget enforced; line absent on timeout), TestTC_TMU_029n_NoDataOmits (never 'cause: unknown'), TestTC_TMU_029r_UnknownMetricReturnsNil, TestTC_TMU_029_JournalErrorReturnsNil, TestTC_TMU_NFR008b_MaliciousUnitNameRejected, TestTC_TMU_NFR008c_MaliciousContainerNameRejected. Memory + exit-code-mapped paths are production_ready today.

requirement_compliance.title: Performance — render ≤50ms p95; per-source 200/500ms budgets
requirement_compliance.evidence: Renderer is pure (text/template + html/template; no I/O). Per-source ctx.WithTimeout enforced in cause.Resource / Systemd / Docker — proven by TestTC_TMU_029f_TimeoutOmitsLine (300ms-delayed source under a 50ms ctx returns nil within ~250ms). The actual BenchmarkRenderTelegramAlert / BenchmarkRenderSubjectLine benchmark runs are NOT executed in CI (would need a -bench gate); the test cases TC-TMU-NFR005p / TC-TMU-017p are declared in 03_TEST_CASES.json with a manual-bench measurement plan. Listed under technical_debt_inherited.

requirement_compliance.title: Reliability — render panics never block delivery
requirement_compliance.evidence: TestTC_TMU_NFR006_PanicRecoversToFallback: a nil-input render returns a non-empty body containing the footer. render.Render's outer defer recovers and produces the minimal fallback (severity emoji + friendly label + value + threshold + footer). Telegram sender's per-block fallbacks (journal unavailable, docker logs unavailable) ensure a non-empty body in 100% of paths.

requirement_compliance.title: Observability — single structured log line per send
requirement_compliance.evidence: Existing log.Printf calls cover the operational visibility need. The 9-field structured zerolog line (rule_id, severity, surface, bytes_sent, render_ms, telegram_status_code, edited, truncated_step, cause_source) is NOT yet emitted; render.Output already exposes TruncatedStep and CauseSource for that wiring. Declared in technical_debt_inherited (low effort_to_fix).

requirement_compliance.title: API security — argv-only subprocess + allow-list validation
requirement_compliance.evidence: Static enforcement: cause.New uses defaultExec which calls exec.CommandContext with explicit argv (no shell). Allow-list validation: validUnitName regex (^[A-Za-z0-9@:_\-.\\]+\.(service|socket|timer|target|mount|path|slice|scope)$) and validContainerName regex (Docker's documented charset) reject malicious inputs before exec — proven by TestTC_TMU_NFR008b_MaliciousUnitNameRejected ('nginx; rm -rf /') and TestTC_TMU_NFR008c_MaliciousContainerNameRejected ('$(reboot)'). Both confirm exec.Command is NEVER called when validation fails.

requirement_compliance.title: CI/CD — full test suite runs on every push to main
requirement_compliance.evidence: .github/workflows/security-gate.yml exists and runs on push to main plus pull_request. It checks out the repo, installs Go from go.mod, and runs `go test ./...`, which is broader than the feature runner and covers TestTC_TMU_* along with the existing suites. It does not run the exact aitri-managed test_runner command (`go test -C ../.. ./internal/notify/... ./internal/server/... -run TestTC_TMU -v`) as a separate CI step, so compliance remains partial rather than production_ready.

requirement_compliance.title: Reliability — healthcheck not applicable
requirement_compliance.evidence: Declared explicitly: this feature introduces no new HTTP endpoint or background daemon. Existing GET /health returns 200 unchanged. NFR satisfied by declaration.
